claims.text: The citizen developer is very good news, one of the best things to happen to software, and a better way to talk about vibe coding.
claims.quote: And I think it is very good news.

claims.text: AWS's own definition is neutral: business users with little or no coding experience, often called citizen developers, can build applications themselves.
claims.quote: Business users with no or little coding experience, often called citizen developers, can build applications themselves.

claims.text: Gartner describes the citizen developer as a persona rather than a job title.
claims.quote: Gartner describes it as a persona rather than a job title.

claims.text: Vibe coding is the term Andrej Karpathy coined in February 2025 for coding where you forget that the code even exists.
claims.quote: the term Andrej Karpathy coined in February 2025 for coding where you "forget that the code even exists"

claims.text: It is not only citizens: the employee, the business owner and the domain expert are building the thing they actually need.
claims.quote: It is the employee developer, the business owner developer, the expert in a domain that technology has served badly for decades, building the thing they actually need.

claims.text: A spreadsheet is a user interface and a database in one file, and the business world runs on them, errors and all.
claims.quote: A spreadsheet is a user interface and a database in one file

claims.text: In Raymond Panko's audits, 49 of 54 spreadsheets audited between 1997 and 2000 contained significant errors.
claims.quote: Of 54 spreadsheets audited between 1997 and 2000, no fewer than 49 were found to contain significant errors

claims.text: JPMorgan's London Whale model ran on Excel spreadsheets completed manually, and at one point divided by a sum instead of an average.
claims.quote: operated through a series of Excel spreadsheets, which had to be completed manually

claims.text: In October 2020 England's test and trace system lost 15,841 positive cases because an old Excel format limited rows to 65,536.
claims.quote: England's test and trace system lost 15,841 positive cases

claims.text: Spreadsheet errors are not an argument against the people who built them; the spreadsheet was the only tool they had that they could change themselves.
claims.quote: the spreadsheet was the only tool they had that they could change themselves

claims.text: The most useful thing about an application built by the person who needs it is the brief: a working app built by the user is a brief that runs.
claims.quote: A working app, built by the user, is a brief that runs.

claims.text: The mistake is treating the brief as if it were already a product; a working app is not yet maintained, secured, documented, tested, versioned or able to scale.
claims.quote: treating the brief as if it were already a product

claims.text: Simon Wardley describes three kinds of people for three stages of anything: explorers, villagers and town planners.
claims.quote: Simon Wardley describes three kinds of people for three stages of anything: explorers, villagers and town planners.

claims.text: The citizen developer is an explorer; villagers take the brief and harden it, and town planners make it scale with the non-functional requirements the explorer never had to think about.
claims.quote: The citizen developer is an explorer, and that is exactly what an explorer should be doing

claims.text: With agents the handover becomes cheap and visible: a move from one folder to another and a version bump, logged and reviewable.
claims.quote: a move from one folder to another and a version bump, logged and reviewable

claims.text: The underrated piece of the puzzle is where these mini apps live.
claims.quote: The piece of the puzzle I think is underrated is where these mini apps live.

claims.text: An sgit vault adds what the spreadsheet never had: history as commits, keys so a reader can see without changing, encryption so it can live anywhere, and a clean handover.
claims.quote: history, so every change is a commit; keys, so a reader can see without being able to change; encryption, so it can live anywhere

claims.text: A vault is a distributed, versioned spreadsheet that can be a whole application.
claims.quote: A vault is a distributed, versioned spreadsheet that can be a whole application

claims.text: The owner already works this way, with small applications and their data in vaults, and the wires on the site are research desks writing vaults the site reads.
claims.quote: I already work this way: small applications with a UI and the data behind them, in vaults

claims.text: Sovereignty is the ability to move, and the ability to build your own tools is the first step to it, for people, organisations and countries.
claims.quote: the ability to build your own tools is the first step to it

claims.text: When the user can build, the business is no longer locking them in; it is serving them well enough that they choose to pay.
claims.quote: it is serving them well enough that they choose to pay

claims.text: This newsroom is testing that with its reading meter, where readers pay after they have read and only for what they valued.
claims.quote: That is what this newsroom is testing with its reading meter, where readers pay after they have read

claims.text: The conference quote attributing the phrase to AWS is untraced; AWS's own definition is quoted instead.
claims.quote: The conference quote is untraced.

claims.text: The spreadsheet error evidence is old: Panko's audits are from 1997 to 2000, though the London Whale and test and trace cases are well documented.
claims.quote: Spreadsheet errors are old evidence.

claims.text: Not every app should be scaled; most citizen-built apps will stay small, and the handover is for the ones that matter.
claims.quote: Not every app should be scaled.

claims.text: Vaults are one carrier, the one the owner uses and builds; the argument does not depend on them.
claims.quote: They are the one I use and build; the argument does not depend on them.

claims.text: The article comes from a voice memo on 14 October 2026 after a conference, written by the site's agent, with the quotes checked on the pages themselves.
claims.quote: A voice memo of mine on 14 October 2026, after a conference
